title: Imbued of the Middle East
summary: The imbuing as a worldwide event, seen from Arab lands.

claims.text: The imbuing is international and touches every culture; it is not a North American or Western phenomenon.
The Heralds enhance people in ways each hunter can grasp through their own experience and limits, so a hunter's culture and faith shape how they hunt and see themselves.
Arab imbued are found across fourteen countries of the Middle East, and most turn out to be much like hunters anywhere else.
Through the Internet many of these hunters now have a voice in the worldwide hunter community, and foreign hunters visiting the region must learn its outlooks and obstacles.
